# symbolicRigidBodyInertiaTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicRigidBodyInertiaTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicRigidBodyInertiaTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The inertia of a rigid body as expressions of named variables of the model (#3159): RigidBodyInertia and
#           its shapes take exudyn.symbolic values - the density rho and the length L of mbs.symbolicVariables in
#           InertiaCuboid(density=rho, sideLengths=[L, 0.1, 0.05]).Translated([L/2, 0, 0]) - and give their mass,
#           inertia and center of mass as expressions; the values equal those of the inertia of numbers. With
#           UserItemCreator.CreateRigidBody, the expressions are the parameters of the user body in parameterBindings,
#           so that SymbolicSystem keeps rho and L in Equations(): the derivatives of the forces and the mass matrix by
#           rho and L equal central differences of the system by SetParameterValues.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-02
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.symbolics.userItems import UserItemCreator
from exudyn.symbolics.systemModel import SymbolicSystem
import numpy as np
esym = exu.symbolic

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()
rho = esym.Real('rho', 1000., scope=mbs)
L = esym.Real('L', 0.4, scope=mbs)

def Inertia(density, length):
    return InertiaCuboid(density=density, sideLengths=[length, 0.1, 0.05]).Translated([0.5*length, 0, 0])

#the inertia of expressions has the values of the inertia of numbers
symbolic = Inertia(rho, L)
numbers = Inertia(1000., 0.4)
def Values(x):
    return np.array([v.Evaluate() if isinstance(v, esym.Real) else v for v in np.array(x, dtype=object).flat], dtype=float)
differenceInertia = max(abs(symbolic.Mass().Evaluate() - numbers.Mass()), np.max(np.abs(Values(symbolic.Inertia()) - numbers.Inertia().flatten())),
                        np.max(np.abs(Values(symbolic.COM()) - numbers.COM())), np.max(np.abs(Values(symbolic.InertiaCOM()) - numbers.InertiaCOM().flatten())))
exu.Print('the inertia of expressions against the one of numbers:', differenceInertia)
failed = int(differenceInertia > 1e-12)

#a pendulum of a rigid body on a spring-damper, the inertia symbolic
creator = UserItemCreator(mbs)
ground = creator.CreateGround()
body = creator.CreateRigidBody(inertia=symbolic, referencePosition=[0, 0, 0], initialAngularVelocity=[0.3, 0.5, 2.],
                               gravity=[0, -9.81, 0], nodeType=exu.NodeType.RotationRxyz)
creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[ground, body], localPosition0=[0.5, 0.2, 0], localPosition1=[0.3, 0, 0], stiffness=500, damping=2)
creator.Record()
mbs.Assemble()
failed += int(sorted(str(x) for x in creator.parameterBindings.Parameters()) != ['L', 'rho'])

system = SymbolicSystem(mbs, parameters=creator.parameterBindings)
equations = system.Equations()
inputs = [equations[name] for name in ['q', 'q_t', 't']] + [rho, L]
F = esym.Function(equations['ODE2RHS'], inputs, 'ODE2RHS')
M = esym.Function(equations['massMatrix'], inputs, 'massMatrix')
rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
(q0, q_t0) = system.InitialState()
(q, q_t, t) = (q0 + 0.05*rng.standard_normal(system.nODE2), q_t0 + 0.3*rng.standard_normal(system.nODE2), 0.)
differenceForces = np.max(np.abs(np.array(F.Evaluate(q, q_t, t, 1000., 0.4)) - system.ODE2RHS(q, q_t, t)))
differenceMass = np.max(np.abs(np.array(M.Evaluate(q, q_t, t, 1000., 0.4)) - system.MassMatrix(q, q_t, t)))
exu.Print('Equations() with rho and L against the system:', differenceForces, differenceMass)
failed += int(not (differenceForces < 1e-10 and differenceMass < 1e-12))

#the derivatives by rho and L against central differences of the system
differences = []
for (name, value, epsilon) in [('rho', 1000., 1e-3), ('L', 0.4, 1e-6)]:
    results = []
    for sign in [1, -1]:
        system.SetParameterValues({name: value + sign*epsilon})
        results.append((system.ODE2RHS(q, q_t, t), system.MassMatrix(q, q_t, t)))
    system.SetParameterValues({name: value})
    for (k, function) in enumerate([F, M]):
        derivative = np.array(function.EvaluateJacobian(name, q, q_t, t, 1000., 0.4))[..., 0]
        central = (results[0][k] - results[1][k])/(2*epsilon)
        differences.append(np.max(np.abs(derivative - central))/max(1., np.max(np.abs(central))))
exu.Print('derivatives by rho and L against central differences:', differences)
failed += int(not max(differences) < 1e-6)

u = failed
exu.Print('solution of symbolicRigidBodyInertiaTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
